name: Events Calendar by AddEvent – Embeddable Event Calendar Plugin
author: AddEvent

sections.description:
AddEvent’s Events Calendar Plugin for WordPress makes it simple to embed a fully responsive, customizable events calendar on your website. Perfect for showcasing upcoming events, conferences, and schedules.

Don’t have an AddEvent account yet? Sign up for your own AddEvent Calendar.

Embed a beautiful event calendar on your website – display your upcoming events and keep your visitors up to date without any extra effort on their part.

AddEvent’s Embeddable Events Calendar plugin lets you display your AddEvent-powered Events Calendar on your website. Install the plugin, add the AddEvent Event Calendar block, and put in the CalendarID of your AddEvent Calendar.

Key Features:
✅ Easy Embedding – Add beautiful, fully responsive event calendars anywhere on your site.
✅ Customize Your Events Calendar – Customize the event calendar through block settings such as inclusion or removal of the calendar name, print button, timezone selector, subscribe buttons, and so forth
✅ Subscribe Button – Let visitors save your event calendar feed in their calendar of choice (Google, Outlook, Apple, etc.).
✅ Real-Time Event Updates & Syncing – Automatically sync event changes without needing manual updates to your website calendar. Events that are added and updated in AddEvent will be reflected on your website in real-time.
✅ Timezone Support – Ensure event times display accurately for global audiences.
✅ Calendar Display Settings – Supports various calendar views (month, week, schedule)

Perfect for businesses, nonprofits, educators, coaches, marketers, and anyone hosting events who wants to share their schedule and calendar on their website! AddEvent’s WordPress plugin makes calendar sharing simple, professional, and effective. Start engaging your audience today!

👉 Install the AddEvent Events Calendar Plugin today and turn your website into an event hub!

Help Center

If you aren’t familiar with AddEvent, check out our YouTube channel filled with getting started videos or our Help Center.

External Services

This plugin integrates with the AddEvent Calendar to display and manage custom event calendars.

  • Service Used: AddEvent
  • What it Does: This service allows embedding and managing event calendars on your WordPress site.
  • Data Sent: When users interact with the calendar, requests are sent to AddEvent’s servers to fetch calendar events.
  • When is Data Sent: Data is transmitted when the calendar is loaded on the webpage.
  • Where is Data Sent: The requests go to https://cdn.addevent.com/libs/cal/js/cal.embed.t1.init.js.
  • Terms of Service: https://www.addevent.com/c/legal/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.addevent.com/c/legal/privacy

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and privacy policy of AddEvent.

Donate

We are not taking donations at this time.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. For more details, visit GNU GPL.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/addevent directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Calendar ID?

You can find your Calendar ID by logging into your AddEvent account. Hover over your calendar name, and click the three dots. From there, click Calendar Page, and your Calendar ID can be found in the top calendar details section. This ID allows you to embed your Events Calendar on your WordPress site.

How do I configure the Calendar ID?

After adding the AddEvent Event Calendar block, enter your Calendar ID in the settings panel to link your Events Calendar.

Can I manage events directly in WordPress?

The plugin uses an external service [AddEvent] (https://www.addevent.com/?utm_source=wordpress&utm_medium=plugin&utm_campaign=embeddable-calendar&utm_term=AddEvent&utm_content=faq) for event management and is not manageable from WordPress.

How do I uninstall the plugin?

Deactivate and delete the plugin from the Plugins menu. All related data will be removed upon deletion.
